title: Medical Virtual Assistant - Prior Authorization Specialist

position_overview:
Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant
- Prior Authorization Specialist
Position Type: Part-Time (20 hours per week)
key_responsibilities:
Top 3 Priorities

1. Prior Authorization Management (Top Priority)
- Process and follow up on prior authorization requests, particularly for medications.
- Coordinate with insurance companies and pharmacies to obtain approvals and resolve authorization issues.
- Track pending requests, monitor statuses, and maintain accurate documentation.

2. Inbound & Outbound Call Management
- Handle incoming and outgoing calls from patients, pharmacies, and insurance representatives.
- Respond to patient inquiries professionally and compassionately.
- Coordinate pharmacy communications and medication-related requests.
- Provide virtual receptionist support and assist with general front-desk inquiries.

3. Medical Administrative & EHR Support
- Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate patient appointments.
- Monitor, organize, and respond to emails.
- Process patient referrals and manage incoming and outgoing faxes.
- Monitor and respond to patient messages through Charm EHR.
- Maintain accurate patient records and support daily administrative operations.

Must-Have Qualifications
- Hands-on prior authorization experience is essential, including processing, tracking, and following up on authorization requests.
- Previous experience in a behavioral health, mental health, or general healthcare setting.
- Strong inbound and outbound call-handling experience, including patient inquiries and pharmacy coordination.
- Experience with patient scheduling, email management, referrals, and medical administrative tasks.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- HIPAA training or certification and a strong understanding of patient confidentiality.
- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple tasks accurately.
- Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating healthcare software and multiple systems.
- Reliable, proactive, self-motivated, and capable of working independently.
- Patient, compassionate, and professional when communicating with patients.
- Must be available to work the required 20-hour weekly schedule in Central Time.

Preferred Qualifications
- Previous experience supporting a psychiatric, behavioral health, or addiction treatment practice.
- Familiarity with Charm EHR or the ability to learn it quickly.
- Experience handling medication-related prior authorizations.
- Familiarity with Ooma VoIP or similar phone systems.
- Previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant or Virtual Medical Receptionist.

A medical degree or professional medical license is not required.

Basic Requirements
- Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
- Must have relevant work experience.
- Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
- Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements
- Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
- Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
- Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
- Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
- Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.
- Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
- Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
- HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
- Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
- Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client's needs and schedule.
- Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
- Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
- Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.
